services.name: Swim Lessons
services.desc: Friendly Park Pool offers group swimming lessons, free of charge, exclusively to members ages 4 and older. Sign-up sheets are available at our annual open house, the weekend before Memorial Day, and in the lifeguard office once the pool is open for the season. Members are encouraged to sign up for more than one session per summer. Swimmers will learn to submerge face, experience buoyancy on front and back, blow bubbles, enter and exit water, and move through water. They will kick on front and back, with support, and they will be introduced to alternating arm action. Basic water safety rules will be taught.
